{{NameSDV|Green Pickles|alt=Jellies and Pickles|alt2=Pickles}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a vegetable [[Crops|Crop]] that can be grown from [[Joja Veggie Seeds]] in 13 days during {{Season|Spring}}, {{Season|Summer}}, and {{Season|Fall}}. Putting {{PAGENAME}} in a [[Stardew:Seed Maker|Seed Maker]] will result in 1 - 2 Joja Veggie Seeds. {{Note|This crop is only available if you take the [[Stardew:JojaMart|Joja Community Development]] route.}} {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Joja Veggie}} ==Crop Growth Calendar== {{#lst:Crop Growth Calendars|Joja Veggie}} ==Multi-Seasonal Crop== {{PAGENAME}} may be planted in Spring, Summer, and Fall. There is no difference in its behavior in either season. If a {{PAGENAME}} plant (of any growth stage) is in the ground on the 28th of Spring or Summer, it will continue growing on the 1st of Summer or Fall as though nothing had changed. [[Stardew:Fertilizer|Fertilizer]] in the ground underneath a {{PAGENAME}} plant on Spring or Summer 28 will not disappear on Summer or Fall 1. Fully-grown {{PAGENAME}} plants may be left unharvested until the 1st of Summer or Fall to prevent fertilizer and tilled soil from disappearing. ==Gifting== {{Gifting |like = Alex, Andy, Apples, Caroline, Claire, Clint, Demetrius, Dwarf, Elliott, Emily, Evelyn, George, Gunther, Gus, Harvey, Jodi, Kent, Krobus, Lance, Leah, Leo, Lewis, Linus, Magnus, Marlon, Marnie, Maru, Morgan, Morris, Olivia, Pam, Penny, Pierre, Robin, Sandy, Scarlett, Sebastian, Shane, Susan, Victor, Willy |neutral = Sophia |dislike = Abigail, Haley, Henchman, Jas, Martin, Sam, Vincent }} ==Recipes== ===Artisan Goods=== {{CraftingRecipes|header}} |- | [[File:Green Juice.png|link=]]||[[Stardew:Juice|Juice]]||{{Description|Juice}}||{{Name|Joja Veggie|1}}||[[Stardew:Keg|Keg]]||{{Duration|6000}}||{{Price|ceil(2.25*1140)}}||{{Price|floor((2.25*1140)*1.4)}} |- | [[File:Green Pickles.png|link=]]||[[Stardew:Jellies and Pickles|Pickles]]||{{Description|Pickles}}||{{Name|Joja Veggie|1}}||[[Stardew:Preserves Jar|Preserves Jar]]||{{Duration|4000}}||{{Price|ceil((2*1140)+50)}}||{{Price|floor(((2*1140)+50)*1.4)}} {{CraftingRecipes|footer}} ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|green}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a green color. ==History==
